# Manage employee leave and return to work

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a worker requests time away or returns from an absence. A confidential approved leave and return plan reconciled with payroll, coverage and local requirements.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Record the request and working arrangements privately

agent-runnable


Collect the relevant dates, work location, schedule, contract and applicable policy without requesting unnecessary medical or family details. Keep sensitive information restricted to the people who need it.

- Sources: [Acas holiday entitlement](https://www.acas.org.uk/checking-holiday-entitlement) · [Acas inductions](https://www.acas.org.uk/inductions)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Confirm entitlement, pay and required process

human · human approval required


HR and local advisers check the actual leave type, eligibility, notices and employment protections. Resolve conflicts between policy and applicable rules rather than applying the source country's entitlement globally.

- Sources: [Acas holiday entitlement](https://www.acas.org.uk/checking-holiday-entitlement) · [Acas inductions](https://www.acas.org.uk/inductions)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Agree the leave and coverage plan

human · human approval required


The authorized manager and HR confirm dates, communications, work handover and any review points with the employee. Record adjustments and distinguish consent to share an update from access to sensitive supporting evidence.

- Sources: [Acas holiday entitlement](https://www.acas.org.uk/checking-holiday-entitlement) · [Acas inductions](https://www.acas.org.uk/inductions)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Implement approved calendar and payroll changes

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators update the relevant systems using the reviewed dates and pay treatment. Check access and communication expectations, retaining evidence of the approved change rather than changing employment terms informally.

- Sources: [Acas holiday entitlement](https://www.acas.org.uk/checking-holiday-entitlement) · [Acas inductions](https://www.acas.org.uk/inductions)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Review the return and reconcile records

human · human approval required


Discuss return arrangements and needed support with the employee and HR. Reconcile payroll and leave balances, confirm role coverage and retain only the evidence required under the applicable retention process.

- Verify: A confidential approved leave and return plan reconciled with payroll, coverage and local requirements.
- Sources: [Acas holiday entitlement](https://www.acas.org.uk/checking-holiday-entitlement) · [Acas inductions](https://www.acas.org.uk/inductions)
